help.add:
bxAgents add
Add a tool, skill, gateway, or other component

USAGE
  bxAgents add [kind] [name] [options]

KINDS
  tool, skill, gateway, subagent, schedule, mcp, interceptor, profile, provider,
  capability, extension

COMMON OPTIONS
  --agent=<name>  Add to a subagent rather than the root agent.
  --dry-run       Preview files without writing them.
  --force         Allow replacing an existing file.
  --yes           Use defaults without prompting.

  Each kind has its own settings; see the full reference below.

EXAMPLES
  bxAgents add
  bxAgents add tool Greeter --dry-run
  bxAgents add gateway web

GLOBAL OPTIONS
  -h, --help            Show help without running a command.
  --projectRoot=<path>  Use another project directory.
  --no-color            Disable color and bold styling.
  --no-banner           Hide the overview's logo.
  Pass values as --flag=value, not --flag value.

FULL REFERENCE
  https://bxagents.ai/cli-reference#add
  bxAgents --help lists all commands.

help.chat:
bxAgents chat
Chat with an agent in your terminal

USAGE
  bxAgents chat [options]

OPTIONS
  --server                  Start a temporary server for the full application.
  --connect=<url>           Chat with an already-running server.
  --token=<token>           API access token for a protected server.
  --api-path=<path>         Custom API path. Default: /__bxagents.
  --port=<number>           Port for the temporary server.
  --agent=<name>            Chat with a named agent.
  --user=<name>             Conversation owner. Default: local.
  --continue                Resume the most recent conversation.
  --session=<number-or-id>  Resume a particular conversation.
  --record[=<file>]         Record the terminal session.
  --inline / --fullscreen   Choose the terminal layout.
  --no-tui                  Use the plain line-by-line chat.

  Requires a prior build. Type / inside chat to discover slash commands.

EXAMPLES
  bxAgents chat
  bxAgents chat --server
  bxAgents chat --connect=http://127.0.0.1:8080

GLOBAL OPTIONS

help.connect:
bxAgents connect
Connect services and sign in to MCP servers

USAGE
  bxAgents connect [id] [tools|off|options] [options]

OPTIONS
  --token-env=<NAME>   Environment variable holding a connector token.
  --stdin              Read a token from standard input.
  --confirm            Approve the connector's stated capabilities.
  --remove             Forget a saved sign-in.
  --port=<number>      Local OAuth callback port; otherwise a free port.
  --no-open            Print the sign-in URL without opening a browser.
  --timeout=<seconds>  Sign-in wait time. Default: 300.
  --user=<name>        Whose connection to use. Default: local.
  --json               Print connection status as JSON.

  Without an id, lists available services and connection status. Secrets are
  sealed in the chat database.

EXAMPLES
  bxAgents connect
  bxAgents connect github --token-env=GITHUB_TOKEN --confirm

help.embed:
bxAgents embed
Manage the agent as an embed on other websites

USAGE
  bxAgents embed <action> [options]

ACTIONS
  create, list, show, disable, rotate

OPTIONS
  --name=<text>     What to call the embed (create).
  --id=<emb_...>    The embed to show, disable or rotate.
  --origin=<urls>   Websites that may show it, comma separated: scheme, host,
                    optional port.
  --tools=<names>   Tools a visitor's turn may use, comma separated.
  --per-minute=<n>  Messages per visitor per minute (default 10).
  --daily=<n>       Messages per day for the embed (default 200).
  --max-chars=<n>   Longest message (default 2000).
  --json            Print results as JSON.

EXAMPLES
  bxAgents embed create --name="Docs helper" --origin=https://docs.example.com

help.vault:
bxAgents vault
Manage sealed runtime secrets

USAGE
  bxAgents vault <action> [options]

ACTIONS
  list, add, edit, remove, status, audit, key

OPTIONS
  --name=<name>             Secret to add, edit, or remove.
  --scope=<agent|user|all>  Which secrets to list.
  --user=<name>             Owner of a user-scoped secret.
  --description=<text>      What the secret is for.
  --hosts=<patterns>        Allowed hosts, comma separated.
  --stdin                   Read the secret value from standard input.
  --value                   Replace a secret's value while editing.
  --yes                     Confirm removal.
  --limit=<number>          Limit audit entries.
  --json                    Print results as JSON.

  Secret values are entered hidden or piped with --stdin, never passed as
  flags.

EXAMPLES
  bxAgents vault list
  bxAgents vault add --name=API_KEY
  bxAgents vault status

GLOBAL OPTIONS
  -h, --help            Show help without running a command.
  --projectRoot=<path>  Use another project directory.
  --no-color            Disable color and bold styling.
  --no-banner           Hide the overview's logo.
  Pass values as --flag=value, not --flag value.

FULL REFERENCE
  https://bxagents.ai/cli-reference#vault

overview:
Usage: bxAgents <command> [options]

GET STARTED
  new            Create an agent project
  add            Add a tool, skill, gateway, or other component
  doctor         Check your environment and project
  inspect        Explore the agent's tools and configuration

BUILD & RUN
  build          Build the application
  chat           Chat with an agent in your terminal
  invoke         Send one message and print the reply
  serve          Start the HTTP server
  test           Run project tests
  clean          Remove build and distribution output

MANAGE YOUR AGENT
  models         List and test models
  sessions       Manage conversations and transcripts
  notes          Manage saved notes
  routines       Manage scheduled work and reports

CONNECT & EXTEND
  connect        Connect services and sign in to MCP servers
  connectors     Browse and check the connector catalog
  skills         Find and install skills from the registry
  extensions     Install and manage CLI and chat extensions

SECURITY & ACCESS
  users          Manage web users and admin roles
  token          Manage API access tokens
  embed          Manage the agent as an embed on other websites
  vault          Manage sealed runtime secrets
  hash-password  Hash a password for web sign-in

OPERATE & SHIP
  logs           Read, follow, or browse agent logs
  stats          View model calls and token usage
  data           Locate the data home and its volumes
  backup         Back up the agent's database, files, and skills
  restore        Restore a data-home backup
  package        Package the application as a .bxa
  deploy         Deploy to a local or remote target

EXAMPLES
  bxAgents new my-agent
  bxAgents build
  bxAgents chat

GLOBAL OPTIONS
  -v, --version         Show the version; use before any command.
  -h, --help            Show help without running a command.
  --projectRoot=<path>  Use another project directory.
  --no-color            Disable color and bold styling.
  --no-banner           Hide the overview's logo.
  Pass values as --flag=value, not --flag value.

LEARN MORE
  bxAgents <command> --help
  Also: bxAgents help <command>
  https://bxagents.ai
